commit.merge_subject: merge: one title treatment across all screens

description:
Owner request 2026-11-17 (verbatim intent): "import from folder'da
title biraz yukarıda görünüyor... settings'i de diğerleriyle uyumlu
hale getir. hepsini library projects exports gibi yap" — every
screen title must match the Library/Projects/Exports treatment
(ScreenHeader: headlineSmall, 16dp start, top 12 / bottom 8).

Settings (ui/settings/SettingsScreen.kt): the old settings spec's
bespoke 32sp SemiBold title (start 20 / top 16) is overruled —
replaced with ScreenHeader(title = settings_title), the same call
shape as the other three browse screens. The dead 32sp style code
and the KDoc bullet claiming the redesign replaced the title on
THIS screen only are removed; the KDoc now names the shared
header. The root Column pads nothing, honoring ScreenHeader's
call-site contract (the title's left edge stays the header's own
16dp; the groups below keep their gutters).
